_comment: KANTO SEASONAL CALENDAR: A comprehensive system tracking festivals, Pokémon behavior changes, and special events throughout the year in the Kanto region.

season_description: The season of renewal and new beginnings, when many Pokémon become more active and start their breeding cycles.

overall_pokemon_behavior.breeding_season: Many Pokémon species begin mating rituals
overall_pokemon_behavior.increased_activity: Pokémon are more energetic and easier to encounter

events.name: Cherry Blossom Festival
events.description: Annual celebration of spring's arrival with cherry blossoms and Grass-type Pokémon.
events.anime_description: A beautiful festival where trainers and Pokémon celebrate the renewal of life and nature.
events.cultural_significance: Represents the harmony between humans and nature

events.name: Pokémon Breeding Season
events.description: Natural breeding season when Pokémon are most likely to produce eggs.
events.anime_description: A time when Pokémon instincts are strong and new life is celebrated throughout the region.
events.cultural_significance: Celebrates the continuation of Pokémon species

season_description: The season of energy and adventure, when Fire-types thrive and outdoor activities peak.

overall_pokemon_behavior.peak_activity: Pokémon are at their most active and energetic
overall_pokemon_behavior.water_seeking: Many Pokémon seek water sources and cooling areas

events.name: Midsummer Fire Festival
events.description: Epic celebration of Fire-type Pokémon with fireworks and flame displays.
events.anime_description: A spectacular festival showcasing the power and beauty of Fire-type Pokémon.
events.cultural_significance: Honors the power of fire and the spirit of passion

events.name: Summer Beach Tournament
events.description: Annual beach tournament featuring Water and Electric-type battles.
events.anime_description: A fun, competitive tournament where trainers battle on sandy beaches by the ocean.
events.cultural_significance: Celebrates summer fun and Water-type Pokémon

season_description: The season of harvest and preparation, when Pokémon gather resources for winter.

overall_pokemon_behavior.gathering_instinct: Pokémon collect berries and prepare for winter
overall_pokemon_behavior.color_changes: Some Pokémon change colors like autumn leaves

events.name: Harvest Moon Festival
events.description: Celebration of the autumn harvest with Pokémon helping gather crops.
events.anime_description: A traditional festival where humans and Pokémon work together to celebrate the harvest.
events.cultural_significance: Celebrates cooperation between humans and Pokémon in agriculture

events.name: Ghost-Type Awakening
events.description: When Ghost-type Pokémon become most active and spiritual energy peaks.
events.anime_description: A mystical time when the boundary between the living and spirit worlds is thinnest.
events.cultural_significance: Honors the memory of departed Pokémon and spiritual connections

season_description: The season of endurance and reflection, when Ice-types thrive and many Pokémon hibernate.

overall_pokemon_behavior.hibernation_period: Some Pokémon become less active or hibernate
overall_pokemon_behavior.ice_type_dominance: Ice-type Pokémon are at their strongest
overall_pokemon_behavior.indoor_seeking: Many Pokémon seek warm indoor locations

events.name: Winter Solstice Celebration
events.description: Celebration of the longest night and the return of light.
events.anime_description: A peaceful celebration where trainers and Pokémon appreciate the quiet beauty of winter.
events.cultural_significance: Celebrates endurance and the promise of spring's return

events.name: Ice Cave Expedition
events.description: Annual expedition to explore ice caves and encounter rare Ice-type Pokémon.
events.anime_description: A challenging adventure that tests trainers' skills in harsh winter conditions.
events.cultural_significance: Tests trainer endurance and respect for Ice-type Pokémon

recurring_events.name: New Moon Mystery
recurring_events.description: Dark-type and Psychic-type Pokémon become more active during new moon nights.
recurring_events.anime_description: Mysterious occurrences and rare Pokémon sightings during the darkest nights.

recurring_events.name: Full Moon Festival
recurring_events.description: Celebration of the full moon with nocturnal Pokémon activities.
recurring_events.anime_description: A magical night when Pokémon and trainers celebrate under the bright moonlight.

recurring_events.name: Weekly Market Day
recurring_events.description: Trading markets open in major cities for Pokémon and items.
recurring_events.anime_description: Bustling markets where trainers gather to trade and share stories.

special_events.name: Indigo League Championship
special_events.description: The most prestigious Pokémon tournament in the Kanto region.
special_events.anime_description: The ultimate test of a trainer's skill and the bond with their Pokémon.
special_events.significance: Determines the strongest trainer in Kanto

special_events.name: Pokémon League Exhibition
special_events.description: International exhibition showcasing Pokémon from different regions.
special_events.anime_description: A grand celebration of Pokémon diversity from around the world.
special_events.significance: Promotes international Pokémon exchange and understanding

spring_migration.description: Flying-type Pokémon return from southern regions

autumn_migration.description: Flying-type Pokémon prepare for winter migration

spring_growth.description: Berry trees bloom and fruit begins to develop
